browse_api.description:
Original 1976 Cotillion Records pressing of Welcome To Our World by Mass Production.

One of the defining albums from the Virginia funk collective that blended funk, soul, jazz, and early disco into a signature sound. Produced by Ed A. Ellerbe, this album includes several fan favorites and dance-floor classics.

A fantastic addition for collectors of classic 1970s funk, disco, soul, and rare groove vinyl.

Track Listing

Side One

  • Welcome To Our World (Of Merry Music)
  • Wine-Flow Disco
  • I Like To Dance
  • Our Thought (To The World)

Side Two

  • Magic
  • Galaxy
  • Just A Song
  • Fun In The Sun
